result.paraphrase: NVIDIA TURING: ROG GeForce RTX graphics cards use the Turing GPU architecture and the all-new RTX platform. As a result, they deliver up to 6X the performance of previous-generation graphics cards while bringing real-time ray tracing and AI to games. DirectX 12: Enable new visual effects and rendering techniques for more lifelike gaming. NVIDIA Shadowplay: Record and share high-quality gameplay videos, screenshots, and livestreams with your friends. Patented Wing-blade Fans provide high air pressure, lower noise levels, IP5X-certified dust resistance, and a 0dB mode for silent gaming.* MaxContact Technology gives 2X more contact with the GPU chip for better thermal transfer. Auto-Extreme Technology uses automation to improve reliability. Super Alloy Power II includes premium alloy chokes, solid polymer capacitors, and an array of high-current power stages to power Turing’s cores. ASUS FanConnect II provides 2 hybrid-controlled fan headers for optimal system cooling. GPU Tweak II offers intuitive performance tuning and thermal controls.
